Sorting works across all the dimensions you asked for. Screenshots under `prototypes/` (live: **http://maker:4001/sort.html**).

**The sort control with your five orders** (`shot-45-sort-newest-default.png` and `shot-46-sort-az-remembered.png`)
A **Sort** dropdown offering **Newest added, Oldest added, Recently updated, Title A–Z, Title Z–A**, defaulting to **Newest added**. When I switched to **Title A–Z**, the list reorders (Rome → Bread → CSS → Rust → Quiet Art → Zettelkasten) and a green line confirms *"Saved 'Title A–Z' as your default order — it'll be used next time too,"* so the app **remembers your preferred default** once you change it.

**Applies to filters and search too** (`shot-47-sort-updated-filtered.png`)
Here **Recently updated** is applied *while* the **To read** filter is active — the three to-read items order by their update time (Bread today → Quiet Art 2 days → Rome 5 days). The chosen order applies consistently to search results and every filtered view, and the count line always states the active order.

To confirm my one assumption: I read **"Recently updated"** as ordering by when you last *changed* the bookmark (edited its title/description/tags/note/status), most-recently-changed first. Is that what you'd expect?

If that's right, this settles sorting. That also wraps up the edge cases I set out to explore — after this I'll note a couple of quality items for later and propose we move to building the real application.
